session_summary: Blue title bar reads 'HH DT, Then Trending Trading Range Day' (overrides the filename phrasing, which names the opening traps instead). Reading: opening bear trap at 3700 area rallies to a 3740 buy climax / higher-high double top (~07:25), then lower-high double top 3730 (~08:30), bear wedge descended under magenta dotted lines and broke down at 10:00 to 3675 (bar 44 midday reversal), followed by a bull trend of higher lows to a 3720 test of the open into the close. Two long opposite-direction swings plus interlocking ranges = trending trading range rather than a one-direction trend. Axis is offset-style with day rolls 10/19 -> 10/20 while hours print 07:00-13:00, so clock labels are shifted relative to pure PT 06:30-13:00; times below are read as printed. On-chart canonical labels: HH DT, LH DT, ii, MM based on open, Bar 44 Midday Reversal, Test of open, Breakout below Wedge, Bear Trap, Buy Climax.
